title: Break-glass Alpha used during the MFA push/SMS outage (MFA-LAB-0003)
narrative: During MFA-LAB-0003 the admins could not complete push or SMS MFA. Two custodians retrieved the FIDO2 key for bg.alpha, signed in (SOC alert fired), and paused a failing CA rollout. Post-use: incident INC-LAB-6001 linked, credentials rotated within 6 hours, and a second admin reviewed every directory audit entry from the session the next morning.
